India has dismissed as "fabricated and malicious" allegations levelled against National Security Adviser Ajit Doval (in picture) and former R&AW chief Samant Goel in a civil lawsuit filed by Khalistani separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in a US court. File. | Photo Credit: PTI
The story so far : A U.S. court on November 9 permitted Khalistani separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun to serve summons on National Security Adviser Ajit Doval and former Research and Analysis Wing (RAW) chief Samant Kumar Goel through Indian courts, in connection with a civil lawsuit alleging a conspiracy to assassinate him. The lawsuit filed by Mr. Pannun, wanted in India on terror charges, is separate but linked to the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation’s findings of an assassination plot against him in June 2023.
